description: This file is a shell script that contains various test cases for the 'git filter-branch' command. It sets up git repositories, performs different filter-branch operations, and checks the results to ensure correct behavior of git's history rewriting features.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting successful execution of commands.

methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of files or command outputs.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Ensures the number of lines in output matches expectation.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used in tests.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies git configuration options.
